items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: There was an African called Fia (phonetic). Pierre.

ctx.x: So, seemed like they rumbled for hours but Gene picked up a table and tore the man's skull up so that was all. Red Grange -- but, now here's two things that I saw happen to Gene.
There was an African called Fia (phonetic). Pierre. Well, this African whatever tribe it was, they had their teeth sawed down and they looked like shark teeth.
